channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from summarizedStoriesMainNLscienceAndDiscovery, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: 60,000-year-old ostrich eggshell engravings reveal a surprisingly sophisticated human mind
item.description: Ancient ostrich eggshell engravings from southern Africa show intricate geometric patterns that suggest advanced cognitive abilities.

item.title: Chemists set electrons free and break a decades-old chemistry barrier
item.description: Chemists have developed a catalyst that overcomes a long-standing rule about electron transfer in chemical reactions.

item.title: Stress may disrupt the brain's internal navigation system, MRI study suggests
item.description: Stress could interfere with the brain's internal GPS. Researchers found that cortisol, a stress hormone, significantly impaired people's spatial navigation abilities.

item.title: Bacteria found to convert toxic uranium into a stable, less harmful form
item.description: Underground bacteria may trap toxic uranium before it spreads. Researchers observed that feeding microbes in uranium-contaminated environments led to the conversion of uranium into a stable form.
